definitions.gloss: biweekly publication; fortnightly; published every other week
definitions.explanation: A publication schedule or format in which issues are released once every two weeks. Used as both a noun and a prenominal modifier to describe the frequency of magazines, newspapers, and other serial publications.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
{隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{漫画雑誌|まんがざっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定期購読|ていきこうどく}→定期購読：16116_teikikoudoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have a subscription to a biweekly manga magazine.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}→週刊：14373_shuukan⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{経費削減|けいひさくげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This newspaper was previously weekly, but it was changed to biweekly to cut costs.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{隔週|かくしゅう}→隔週：15282_kakushuu⟧ (every other week, biweekly) and {刊|かん} (publication, issue). Part of the ～{刊|かん} publication frequency pattern.

PUBLICATION FREQUENCY PATTERN:
- ⟦{日刊|にっかん}→日刊：19258_nikkan⟧: daily
- ⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}→週刊：14373_shuukan⟧: weekly
- {隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}: biweekly (every two weeks)
- ⟦{月刊|げっかん}→月刊：16257_gekkan⟧: monthly
- {隔月刊|かくげつかん}: bimonthly
- ⟦{季刊|きかん}→季刊：02787_kikan⟧: quarterly

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}{誌|し}: biweekly magazine
- {隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to publish biweekly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}→週刊：14373_shuukan⟧: weekly — published once per week
- ⟦{月刊|げっかん}→月刊：16257_gekkan⟧: monthly — published once per month
- {隔月刊|かくげつかん}: bimonthly — published once every two months
